commerceErrors.COMMERCE_AMOUNT_INVALID: This amount is not valid. Enter a positive number, for example 12.50.
commerceErrors.COMMERCE_REQUEST_INVALID: Some required information is missing or incorrect. Check the form.
commerceErrors.COMMERCE_CURRENCY_INVALID: This currency is not valid. Use a three-letter code, for example EUR.
commerceErrors.COMMERCE_CURRENCY_MISMATCH: The currencies do not match: a basket, an order and its lines share one currency.
commerceErrors.COMMERCE_PRODUCT_INVALID: This product handle is not usable. Use lower-case letters, digits and single hyphens, for example "wool-scarf".
commerceErrors.COMMERCE_PRODUCT_HANDLE_TAKEN: This handle is already used by another product. Choose another one.
commerceErrors.COMMERCE_PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND: This product no longer exists. Refresh the list.
commerceErrors.COMMERCE_VARIANT_NOT_FOUND: This variant no longer exists. Remove the line and try again.
commerceErrors.COMMERCE_SKU_TAKEN: This SKU is already used by another variant (or it is empty). A SKU identifies one sellable item.
commerceErrors.COMMERCE_OUT_OF_STOCK: There is not enough stock for this quantity.
commerceErrors.COMMERCE_CART_CLOSED: This basket has already been ordered or abandoned.
commerceErrors.COMMERCE_QUANTITY_INVALID: This quantity is not valid. Enter a positive whole number.
commerceErrors.COMMERCE_ORDER_TRANSITION_INVALID: This order cannot move to that status from its current state.
commerceErrors.COMMERCE_ORDER_LOCKED: This order can no longer be edited: only an order awaiting payment can be corrected.
commerceErrors.COMMERCE_PAYMENT_FAILED: The payment could not be processed. Only a collected payment can be refunded.
commerceErrors.COMMERCE_PAYMENT_UNSUPPORTED: The active payment method does not support this operation.
commerceErrors.COMMERCE_PAYMENT_SIGNATURE_INVALID: The payment notification could not be verified.
commerceErrors.COMMERCE_PAYMENT_ALREADY_RECORDED: This order already has a collected payment.
commerceErrors.COMMERCE_PAYMENT_NOT_CONFIGURED: Payment is not configured on this site.
commerceErrors.COMMERCE_REFUND_EXCEEDS_PAYMENT: The refund exceeds what was paid. Check the amount already refunded.
commerceErrors.COMMERCE_REFUND_NO_PAYMENT: No collected payment is recorded for this order, so there is nothing to refund. Record the payment first.
commerceErrors.COMMERCE_TAX_RULE_INVALID: This tax rule is not valid. The rate must be between 0 and 100 %.
commerceErrors.COMMERCE_TAX_RULE_UNKNOWN: This tax rule no longer exists.
commerceErrors.COMMERCE_SHIPPING_METHOD_UNKNOWN: This shipping method does not exist.
commerceErrors.COMMERCE_SHIPPING_UNAVAILABLE: This shipping method is not available for this order.
commerceErrors.COMMERCE_COUPON_NOT_FOUND: This coupon code does not exist.
commerceErrors.COMMERCE_COUPON_INVALID: This coupon is not valid. Check its value, its dates and its usage limits.
commerceErrors.COMMERCE_COUPON_CODE_TAKEN: This coupon code already exists. Choose another one or edit the existing coupon.
commerceErrors.COMMERCE_COUPON_EXHAUSTED: This coupon has been used the maximum number of times.
commerceErrors.COMMERCE_COUPON_CUSTOMER_EXHAUSTED: This customer has already used this coupon the maximum number of times.
commerceErrors.COMMERCE_COUPON_NOT_APPLICABLE: This coupon does not apply to anything in the order.
commerceErrors.COMMERCE_INVOICE_NOT_FOUND: This order has no invoice yet.
commerceErrors.COMMERCE_INVOICE_ALREADY_ISSUED: An invoice has already been issued for this order.
commerceErrors.COMMERCE_INVOICE_SEQUENCE_CONFLICT: Two invoices were issued at the same time. Try again.
commerceErrors.COMMERCE_INVOICE_NOT_CONFIGURED: Invoicing is not configured: fill in the seller details in the shop settings.
commerceErrors.COMMERCE_SUBSCRIPTION_INVALID: This subscription cannot be changed that way. Check its state and what you entered.
commerceErrors.COMMERCE_CUSTOMER_EMAIL_INVALID: This e-mail address is not usable.
commerceErrors.COMMERCE_TRACKING_INVALID: The tracking is not valid: carrier and number are required, the link must start with http:// or https://, and the order must be paid.
commerceErrors.COMMERCE_CREDIT_NOTE_NOT_FOUND: This credit note does not exist.
commerceErrors.FORBIDDEN: You are not allowed to do this.
commerceErrors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session has expired. Sign in again.
commerceErrors.DRIVER_UNAVAILABLE: The payment service cannot be reached.
commerceErrors.DRIVER_UNKNOWN: This payment method does not exist.
commerceErrors.DRIVER_INIT_FAILED: The payment service could not start.
commerceErrors.INTERNAL: Something went wrong in the shop. Try again in a moment.
